title: Coherence of descended scalar section maps
statement: Let I be any preorder and D:I^op -> Scheme any diagram with a cone c. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves with inverse-image transition maps phi satisfying their identity and composition laws. Let G be a diagram of sheaves on c.pt identified with the pullbacks of F_i by eG and satisfying the prescribed hG transition formula, and let L be any cocone on G. Fix i0 and any etale object T0. On J={j | i0 <= j}, define Tj, Tlim, gamma, delta, rho and mu exactly by the base changes, adjunction-unit formulas and projection equations of lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-scalar-section-zero-eventually. Then rho_id=id, rho_(a composed b)=rho_a composed rho_b, and rho_a composed mu_k=mu_j. No directedness, geometric finiteness or limit hypothesis is required. The notions are those of def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-pc-fibre-product.

source.place: Sites Tags 03CB and 09YN, unit-compatible composition of inverse images and the stage-section transition formula.

proof.text: Use pullback.hom_ext and the defining projection equations to identify each supplied identity comparison with pullbackId. For compositions, the first projections of pullbackComp followed by the two supplied comparisons agree with the direct comparison by pullbackComp_left_fst_fst; their second projections agree because all maps are morphisms over the base. Cancel the comparison isomorphisms to obtain the inverse-map pasting equation used on sections. These are calculations from the chosen fibre-product universal property, not an application of paste_vert_iff.

Apply upperStarId_hom_app_unit_app to the identity transition and evaluate at Tj. Identify the geometric comparison using the preceding uniqueness argument and cancel its inverse. Eliminate equality transport with abstract functors and apply the section expression as a function of the underlying preorder arrow, avoiding unfolding the sheafification construction. This proves rho_id=id.

Prove the transpose-of-composition equation from upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app, the composite-adjunction unit formula, and naturality of the composition isomorphism and the adjunction unit. Evaluate this sheaf equation at Tj and use presheaf naturality to move restriction along gamma.inv past the second transposed map. The inverse-map pasting equation identifies the final restriction. Substitute hcomposition to obtain rho_(a composed b)=rho_a followed by rho_b.

Cancel eG_j.hom in the sheaf equation for eG_j.inv followed by the cocone leg. Substitute hG and L.w to identify this morphism with upperStarComp.hom followed by the pulled-back transition phi and eG_k.inv followed by its cocone leg. Apply the same evaluated transpose-of-composition calculation, with gamma, delta_k and delta_j as the geometric comparisons. This proves rho_a followed by mu_k=mu_j.

proof_origin.place: Sites Tags 03CB and 09YN; inverse-image unit and section-transition calculations. Complete Lean proof by D3 using the existing Coherence module and Mathlib pullback uniqueness and pullbackComp.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image adjunction units and pullback composition give functorial transition maps on sections of varying etale sheaves
A section of a compatible system of etale abelian sheaves on an inverse limit is zero if and only if it becomes zero at a later stage
mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_appTop_map_eq_zero_of_isLimit and exists_app_map_eq_zero_of_isLimit concern structure sheaves, not arbitrary etale abelian sheaves. No matching geometric comparison.

SectionContinuity gives a fixed-base sheaf result; ColimitSites and ColimitSiteAbelianSectionUniversality give fixed-sheaf inverse-image presentations. Coherence has upperStarId_hom_app_unit_app and upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app, but no laws for this varying sheaf system.

from.place: Step 3 of the acyclic-replacement plan, scalar continuity used in the finite Cech-complex comparison of 09YP.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_limit_scalar_section_map_laws
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    (i₀ : I) (T₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) :
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let Tj := fun j : J ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
        (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).obj T₀
    let Tlim := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj T₀
    ∀ (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tj k)
      (δ : ∀ j : J,
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tlim),
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (γ j k a).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
      (∀ j : J,
        (δ j).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
    let ρ := fun (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (φ (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a)).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (F k.val).obj.map (γ j k a).inv.op
    let μ := fun j : J ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (c.π.app (op j.val))).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (eG j.val).inv.hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (L.ι.app j.val).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        L.pt.obj.map (δ j).inv.op
    (∀ j : J, ρ j j (𝟙 j) = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ (j k l : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l),
      ρ j l (a ≫ b) = ρ j k a ≫ ρ k l b) ∧
    (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), ρ j k a ≫ μ k = μ j)
